Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety-tier review. I checked the change against current upstream/main AGENTS.md and issue #2356.

- All four posts refuse positive G73 and G84 dwell requests by name.
- The guards check the raw dwell before positioning and before the open-cycle shortcut.
- The tests cover an open cycle group and fractional millisecond input. Zero-dwell cycles remain available.
- The application blocks posting when these warnings occur.
- No goldens changed. No UI, process, dependency or build-script files changed.
- The decision record explains the conservative refusal. The diagnostic states a post limitation. The [Haas G73 reference](https://haascnc.com/service/codes-settings.type=gcode.machine=mill.value=G73.html) confirms that the control supports dwell; the post does not implement it.

Local results: I fetched the PR into `.claude/worktrees/review-2387` and trial-merged upstream/main at `3c3a586865caba0b5dd45b241ff3396a76963a14`. Git reported that it was already up to date. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-post --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --only 'post suites'`: all 43 mapped post suites passed. Total: 316 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

I independently repeated two mutations. For each mutation, I temporarily restored one post script from upstream/main:

1. Fanuc: both G73 and G84 refusal tests failed. With the fixed script restored, both tests passed.
2. Haas: both G73 and G84 refusal tests failed. With the fixed script restored, both tests passed.

The mutation failures reported a missing named dwell refusal at `crates/post/tests/cycle_dwell.rs:86`. After restoration, the full `cycle_dwell` suite passed all nine tests. The tracked worktree was clean.

Requested changes: none.

Limits: I ran the mapped post suites, not the mapped app suites. I checked the application warning boundary by source review. No controller hardware was tested. Native dwell output remains unsupported by these posts. The four existing post files exceed the file-size guideline; this change adds six lines to each.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
